# Software

I build tools that make environmental data easier to find, inspect, and use in reproducible research.

## Climate

::: {.software-feature}

::: {.software-mark}

R

:::

::: {.software-copy}

<p class="software-kicker">R package · open source</p>
<h2>Climate</h2>
<p>Obtain in-situ meteorological and hydrological data from publicly available repositories. The package is designed to make common climate data workflows more direct and reproducible.</p>

## What I care about in software

::: {.principle-grid}

::: {.principle}

<span class="principle-index">01</span>
<h3>Reproducibility</h3>
<p>Clear workflows that can be revisited, shared, and extended.</p>

:::

::: {.principle}

<span class="principle-index">02</span>

:::

::: {.principle}

<span class="principle-index">03</span>
